data.body_html:
Get ready for the most anticipated motorsport event on the Costa del Sol. The F1 Grand Prix 2039 yacht charter Marbella weekend combines high-octane racing with the luxury of a private boat. Depart from Puerto Banús, anchor near the action, and enjoy world-class service onboard. Whether you're a die-hard fan or just here for the party, this is the ultimate way to experience the Grand Prix.

Why Choose a Yacht Charter for the F1 Grand Prix 2039?

Watching from land means queues, crowds, and limited views. On a yacht, you get front-row seats to the race—plus the freedom to sail to quieter spots like Cala del Faro or Cabopino. Our fleet of 16 boats, from the 6.4m Mariah SX21 to the 29m Ferretti 94, accommodates groups of 5 to 12 guests. Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks. No hidden fees.

Our Fleet for the F1 Weekend

Choose your vessel based on group size and budget. All boats depart from Puerto Banús, the heart of Marbella's luxury marina.

For other boats like the Pershing 46, Fairline Targa, or Lagoon 380, contact us via WhatsApp for custom pricing.

What's Included in Your Charter

Every booking comes with: a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No surprises. Just bring your sunscreen and race-day spirit.

Best Spots to Watch the F1 Grand Prix from Your Yacht

While the official circuit is inland, the atmosphere spills onto the coast. Anchor near Marbella Marina or Puerto Banús, where big screens and live commentary create a festival vibe. For a quieter experience, sail to Cala Cortés or Cabopino. The skipper knows the best anchorages.

Sample Itinerary for a 4-Hour Charter

  • 14:00 – Board at Puerto Banús. Welcome cava and snacks.
  • 14:30 – Set sail towards Marbella Marina. Race commentary on deck.
  • 15:00-17:00 – Anchor near the action. Enjoy drinks, swim if weather permits.
  • 17:30 – Cruise back along the Golden Mile, with views of La Concha.
  • 18:00 – Return to Puerto Banús. Disembark.

Longer charters (8 hours) allow you to visit Estepona or Sotogrande.

How to Book Your F1 Grand Prix 2039 Yacht Charter

Demand is high, so early booking is essential. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours. Tier B boats (Mangusta 80) require a minimum 4-hour charter at €4,719, with a free jet ski included. For all other boats, contact us via WhatsApp for availability and custom pricing.

Frequently asked questions

When is the F1 Grand Prix 2039 in Marbella?

The exact dates for the 2039 F1 Grand Prix are yet to be confirmed, but historically the Spanish Grand Prix is held in late May or early June. We recommend booking your yacht charter well in advance as demand surges during race weekend.

Can we watch the F1 race from the yacht?

Yes, you can anchor near Marbella Marina or Puerto Banús and watch the race on onboard screens or from the deck. Many guests enjoy the atmosphere with drinks and snacks while following the action live.

Which boats are best for a group of 10–12 people?

For groups of 10–12, we recommend the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax), Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax), or Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax). These offer ample deck space and comfort for a race-day party.

What is included in the charter price?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours.

Can we depart from a marina other than Puerto Banús?

All our boats depart from Puerto Banús. That said, you can sail to nearby marinas like Cabopino or Estepona during your charter. Just coordinate with your skipper on the day.

Is there a minimum booking duration for the F1 weekend?

For peak events like the F1 Grand Prix, we recommend a minimum of 4 hours to fully enjoy the experience. Tier B boats (e.g., Mangusta 80) require a minimum 4-hour charter at €4,719.

How do I book a yacht for the F1 Grand Prix 2039?

You can book directly through our website or via WhatsApp for custom pricing and availability. Given high demand, early booking is advised. Contact us for the latest options and dates.

What happens if the weather is bad on race day?

Your safety is our priority. If weather conditions are unsafe, we will work with you to reschedule or offer a full refund. The skipper will assess conditions before departure.
